processNotes: The work-center sequence follows the historical route for product 814; its operations are inferred, not an engineering specification.
Frame geometry, joint placement, decal placement and fork retention details are not supplied. The illustration and fit-up are schematic assumptions, not fabrication geometry.
The manufactured fork is available as a completed subassembly. Its retention hardware and installation method are not specified, so final attachment is not assumed.
variantNotes: The primary recipe is black, size 38, product 814. Products 942, 904, 905 and 906 are silver in sizes 38, 40, 42 and 46 respectively.
Each silver variant lists 8 OZ of Paint - Silver, product 494, in place of the representative product's 8 OZ of Paint - Black, product 492.

The supplied variant BOMs list the same other direct component IDs and quantities. They do not specify size-dependent geometry or additional component substitutions; do not infer interchangeable frame sizes.

100151.title: Schematic frame member fit-up
guidance: Use an assumed frame alignment jig to arrange Head Tube (Product Number HT-8019), Top Tube (Product Number TO-2301), Down Tube (Product Number DT-2377) and Seat Tube (Product Number ST-9828) as a schematic main frame.
Include 2 EA of Chain Stays (Product Number CS-2812) and 4 EA of Seat Stays (Product Number SS-2985) in the fit-up. Their exact attachment geometry is not supplied.
